messages:
Marta: Quick sync  ran a three-way bring-up for 'quokka-11b' (int8 vs int6 vs int4). Wanted a short cost-vs-quality summary and a recommended routing plan for GTN.

Jin: Nice  sample sizes and harness?

Marta: Onboard harness, 300 samples per slice (chat/search/longform). Top-line econ: infra cost per 1k tokens = int8 $0.014, int6 $0.008, int4 $0.005. Rough savings vs int8: int6 ~43%, int4 ~64%.

Priya: Latency/throughput?

Marta: Latency p95 (standard node): int8=140ms, int6=230ms, int4=320ms. Throughput drop: ~20% int6, ~35% int4.

Omar: Quality deltas? Any concentrated failure modes?

Marta: Short summary: average chat QA small for int6 (-0.03 on 5pt), larger for int4 (-0.25). Retrieval MRR: int6 -0.9% abs, int4 -2.4% abs. Longform ROUGE-L: int6 -0.6, int4 -1.8. Hallucination proxy increases: int6 +0.6%, int4 +2.1% (numeric/date extractions and multi-step arithmetic). Also saw truncation artifacts on very long contexts with int4.

Jin: What's the noise level? 300 samples enough?

Marta: Moderately noisy: bootstrap CI for MRR ~+/-0.6% at 300. Recommend a 1k-sample shadow for retrieval and a 48h staged canary for live traffic if we proceed.

Priya: Operational recommendation?

Marta: Proposal: three-tier hybrid routing:
- Tier A (Precision): int8 for retrieval, billing, invoices, numeric-exact tasks, "must-be-correct" flows.
- Tier B (Balanced): int6 for default chat and most interactive UIs (good cost/quality trade).
- Tier C (Economy): int4 for asynchronous, non-interactive batch jobs (bulk summarization, nightly indexing), never for interactive customer-facing retrieval.

Marta: Canary sketch: 1) Run 1k shadow for retrieval (compare MRR + halluc proxy). 2) If OK, staged live rollout: chat -> 2% int6, 0% int4 for 24h then 10% int6, 5% int4 for 48h. Retrieval: 0% int4, 5% int6 for 48h. Rollback gates: MRR delta >0.5% for Tier B, >1.5% for Tier C; hallucination_proxy increase >1.0% absolute triggers immediate rollback for that tier.

Omar: Any quick prompt heuristics to protect routes?

Marta: Early detection rules: if prompt contains tokens like ["invoice","total","sum of","as of","convert","balance","what is the amount"], force Tier A (int8). Also detect multi-step numeric pattern: more than 2 arithmetic operations OR >3 numeric tokens -> force int8. For long contexts (>8k chars) avoid int4.

Jin: Can you paste a prototype routing snippet?

Marta: Pseudo:
```
rule {
  if request.metadata.tags contains any of ["retrieval","billing","numeric-exact"] -> model: quokka-11b-int8
  else if request.estimated_tokens < 1500 and not request.metadata.latency_sensitive -> model: quokka-11b-int6
  else if request.metadata.job_type == "batch_summarize" and request.estimated_tokens > 1000 -> model: quokka-11b-int4
  fallback: quokka-11b-int8
}
```

Priya: GTN blurb draft?

Marta: "Quokka-11b int6 offers ~40% infra savings with small, targeted quality regressions; int4 offers deeper savings but larger quality impacts. Recommend three-tier routing: keep int8 for precision endpoints, use int6 as default for chat, reserve int4 for asynchronous batch work. Start with 1k shadow for retrieval and a staged canary with strict MRR/hallucination gates."

Omar: Action items: Marta run 1k shadow job for retrieval; Priya draft the one-pager for GTN; Jin enumerate top 20 prompt failure patterns to feed prompt-detection rules.

Marta: Will run the 1k job tonight and upload results. DeployBot  can you schedule the initial 2% chat canary (int6) after the 1k job completes?

DeployBot: Canary scheduled: quokka-11b-int6 chat route 2% start=2026-03-27T02:00Z. Monitors: Retrieval_MRR, Chat_MeanQA, latency_p95, hallucination_proxy.

Priya: Great, thanks. We'll hold GTN messaging until the 1k shadow is in. :thumbsup:

Marta: I'll post the 1k artifact + sample failures when ready.
